title: Chat model picker exposes only operator-aliased models; a non-aliased deployment model cannot be selected
steps: Run the workspace model policy test against the branch source with the TAP reporter.
Require the named assertion below to pass; this case does not call a paid LLM or mutate a user session.
expect: Enabling a deployment route for the backend does not expose it in the picker while its model_aliases is empty: routableProviders stays without that route.
Once one model under the route is aliased, only that model appears under the route, renamed to its alias.
selectModel of a non-aliased deployment model is refused with session/model-unavailable, including a wire-encoded tp_/tm_ id resolved against the host catalogue.
modelLabels still resolves a now-hidden historical pick to its label.
fence: apps/tracy-web/src/workspace/model-policy.js and lib/model-providers.js (restrictToAliasedModels / isApprovedDeploymentModel): deployment routes expose only aliased models and selectModel enforces the same, independent of the backend-enabled flag.

tests: proxy reads current ops state and rejects stale picks before reaching dsh
